5. Plaintiff's further case is that on 1-1-1993 the defendant-respondent-opposite party Nos. 1 to 3 claimed the independent title in the suit pond on the basis of purchase of the same by their father Md Hanif and restrained the plaintiffs from using the water of the pond and claimed the yearly sale proceed of the fish. Then defendant Nos. 1 to 8 disclosed that SA Khatian and mutation were exclusively prepared in the name of their father Md Hanif. On enquiry it was revealed that said mutation case was a forged one; that the defendant had no independent title and possession in the suit pond. On the other hand, the defendant Nos. 9 to 12 acquired title in the suit pond by virtue of adverse possession. Aa the defendant Nos. 1 to 8 claimed independent title in the suit pond and also restrained the plaintiffs from enjoying usufruct of the pond, hence plaintiffs are constrained to file the suit. 

 6. Defendant Nos. 1 to 3 contested the suit by filing a written statement alleging, inter alia, that the suit is not maintainable, that the payment of the court fee is not proper and that there is no cause of action of the suit. It is further stated that the plaintiffs are not in possession of the suit pond; that Haji Gandu Kha and Haji Mia Kha were not brothers as their fathers are different, and that Haji Mia Kha was the son of Pagan Bepari and Gandhu Kha was the son of Haji Ashrafuddin. Defendants' further contention is that CS record was correctly prepared in the name of Haji Mia Kha and that on the death of Haji Mia Kha, his heirs executed and registered solenama on 27-8-1916 and according to the terms of solenama the suit pond fell into the saham of his son Md Yasin Khan; that Yasin Khan left Abdul Mazid Kha, Abdul. Mannaf Kha, Abdur Rashid Kha and two daughters Kamrunnessa and Amirunnessa and a wife Mariam Bibi, that other heirs died leaving sons and daughters who acquired the permanent marashi title under the sikim taluk of Abdul Khaleque and Abdul Alek; that all the interests were extinguished after the acquisition of Zamindari system and SA record was prepared correctly in the name of Abdul Mazid and Abdul Mannaf, son of Yasin Kha, Nazir Ahmed Kha and Abdul Hamid, sons of Abdul Rashid in equal share. It is further stated that the father of the defendant Nos. 1 to 8 Md Hanif purchased the suit pond on 29-5-1973 by registered deed No. 13424 from Abdul Mannaf Khan, Nazir Ahmed Khan and Abdul Hamid Khan and later on 16-4-1980 purchased also the share of Abdul Majid Kha through registered deed No. 8112 dated 16-4-1980 and that the defendants Nos. 1 to 8 have been possessing the suit pond by paying the rents in the name of their father Md Hanif Miah who mutated his name in SA khatian. It is further stated that plaintiff brought the suit on false claims upon the suit pond as they never possessed the suit pond nor did they acquire title in suit pond, that Gandhu Kha had no title in the suit pond and thus the plaintiffs received nothing from him. Hence the suit is liable to be dismissed. 

 11. Mr Shasti Sarker, the learned Advocate for the petitioners, submits that the learned trial Court as well as the appellate Court erred in law, fact and equity in misreading of the evidence on record and in misappreciating, particularly, evidence of PWs 4 and 5 thereby arrived at wrong conclusion that the brotherhood of Haji Gandu Kha Bepari and Haji Mia Kha was not proved. He further submits that the learned Court below erred in law and facts in misconstruing the evidence on record in asmuch as, the plaintiff by adducing witnesses PW 1 to PW 5 clearly proved the plaint case; that the suit pond was the ejmali property of plaintiffs and the defendant Nos. 1 to 8 as the successors of Haji Miah Kha; that the record of the suit pond in the name of Haji Mia Kha in CS, SA and RS khatian was clearly wrong and that the learned Courts below committed error of law resulting in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice. 

 15. It is not disputed that the suit pond measuring 0.62 acres appertaining to CS plot No. 36 of CS Khatian No. 13 under Mandail Mouza of Keranigonj PS in the District of Dhaka. There is no denying of the fact that CS Khatian No. 13 was recorded in the name of Haji Mia Kha, son of Late Palton Kha Bepari, that SA record was prepared in the name of Majid Kha and Abdul Mannaf Kha, son of Md Yasin Kha, Nazir Ahmed Kha and Abdul Hamid, son of Abdul Rashid and that the suit plot was mutated in the name of Md Hanif Miah, son of late Abdul Malek Miah and who also paid rent to the government. 

 16. The case of the plaintiffs is that Hazi Gandu Kha took lease of 0.62 acres of land from suit plot in 1310 in the names of his 2(two) sons namely, Abdul Khaleque and Abdul Malek, but there is no document in support of their contention and no record was prepared on the basis of alleged settlement. It transpires that CS record was prepared in the name of Haji Mia Kha. Thereafter, the plaintiff has taken different view that Haji Gandu Khan and Miah Kha are full brothers and that Haji Mia Kha being eldest brother collusively prepared CS record in his name, in spite of such wrong record the heirs of Gandu Kha have been retaining title and possession in the suit pond and that on 1-1-1993 when defendant Nos. 1 to 8 in collusion with defendant No. 14 threatened the peaceful possession of the plaintiffs, then they filed suit for declaration in respect of the suit pond and for permanent injunction restraining defendant Nos. 1 to 12 from enjoying the suit pond and for declaring the SA. Khatian fraudulent and collusive and not binding upon the plaintiffs. 

 17. The defence case, on the other hand, is that Haji Mia Kha, son of Palton Kha, had been possessing the suit pond by virtue of Settlement and thus CS khatian was correctly prepared in his name which is marked Exhibit 'Ka'. Haji Mia Kha transferred the suit plot to some of his heirs by different Heba Deeds but subsequently, dispute arose among the heirs of Haji Mia Kha which was resolved by a registered sole-deed dated 27-8-1996 which is marked Exhibit 'X' and as per the terms of solenama the suit plot was devolved upon Yasin Kha who died leaving 4 (four) sons namely, Mojid Kha, Abdul Mannan Kha, Abdur Rashid Kha and Roshid and 2 (two) daughters named Kameronnessa and Ameronnessa and widow Moriom Bibi. After the death of Morion Bibi, Ameronnessa and Rashid Kha, Majid Kha and Monnaf Kha, sons of Yasin, Nazir Ahmed Kha and Hamid Kha, son of Rashid Kha got the suit land by way of inheritance and by virtue of registered kabala deed dated 7-5-1973 marked exhibit 'Gha' and thus the SA record was prepared in the names of Abdul Majid Kha, Abdul Mannaf Kha, Nazir Ahmed Kha and Abdul Hamid Kha in equal share and SA record is marked exhibit Ka(1). It transpires that Abdul Majid and others paid rent to the government by rent receipts marked exhibit 'Ga' and it further transpires that father of defendant Nos. 1 to 8 Md Hanif purchased the suit pond from Mannaf Kha, Nazir Ahmed Kha, Abdul Rashid Kha and Abdul Hamid Kha by virtue of Kabala deed No. 13424 executed on 7-5-1973 marked exhibit 'Gha' and Md Hanif Miah also purchased the share of Abdul Mazid Kha by a registered Kabala No. 8112. Thus, Md Hanif Miah acquiring title of the suit land had been possessing suit land paying rent to the government by a rent receipt marked exhibit 'Ga'/1 and RS Khatian is marked Exhibit Ka /2 was prepared in his name and his name was mutated and the mutation khatian is marked exhibit 'kha'. After the death of Md Hanif Miah, his heirs, defendant Nos. 1 to 8, have been possessing the suit pond. 

 20. CS Khatian proves that father's name of Haji Miah Kha was Paltan Kha but plaintiffs without filing any document failed to prove that Gandu Kha's father's name was also Paltan Kha. The plaintiff No. 1 as PW 1 admitted in his evidence that Mia Kha hails from village Amirabagh and that the village of Gandu Kha is at Kusiarbagh. PW 2 Basu Mia knows nothing about the relationship of Gandu Mia Kha and Miah Kha. PW 5 deposed that he has no document to show that Haji Gandu Kha and Mia Kha are full brothers. PW 3 Ishaque Mia deposed nothing on this point. PW 4 Aynal Hoque deposed that he has nothing to show that Gandhu Kha and Miah Kha are brothers. 

 30. Here, in this case, the plaintiffs claim the suit pond firstly by way of lease and alternatively by inheritance showing Gandu Kha as full brother of Mia Kha and both the assertions of the plaintiffs have been proved false. When the assertions of the plaintiffs have not been proved, than as per provision of section 103 of the Evidence Act, the burden rebuts to the defendants. Then we have to see how far the assertions of defendants have been proved. It appears from the evidence on record that the predecessors of the defendant Haji Mia Kha claimed title in suit pond by way of settlement and accordingly, CS record was prepared in the name of Mia Kha, that the heirs of Mia Kha transferred the suit pond to Abdul Mannaf Kha and others and on the basis of this sale deed, SA record was prepared in the name of Abdul Mannaf, Abdul Majid, Nazir Ahmed and Abdul Hamid and the Khatian market Exhibit Ka(1) who also paid rent through rent receipt marked Exhibit 'Ga'. It further transpires from evidence that Abdul Mannaf and others having right, title, interest and possession in the suit pond transferred the same in favour of Md Hanif Mia by a kabala deed No. 13424 dated 7-5-1993 marked exhibit-Gha who also mutated his name through mutation khatian marked Exhibit Kha(2) and Hanif Miah also paid rent by rent receipt marked Exhibit Ga(1). Thus the assertion of the defendants to the effect that they have title and possession in the suit pond has been proved.
